verdict.rationale: Orama's GitHub README lists "Typo Tolerance" as a feature, so the core claim that searches tolerate misspellings is evidenced, but only as a bare feature-list mention. Nothing in the pack shows it is on by default or that developers can tune when or how fuzzy matching applies. Missing for 10: evidence of out-of-the-box default behavior, documented tunable parameters (e.g., edit-distance tolerance, per-property or minimum-length rules), in-depth docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
